title: Dodo Payments Refund Idempotency and Dead Reckoning
hypothesis: H3: Retry is not idempotent at processor; Dead Reckoning requires embedded action_id in reason

duplicate_call_without_header.conclusion: Naive retry creates multiple distinct refunds until balance or wallet funds are exhausted.

idempotency_key_header_support.conclusion: Dodo Payments refund endpoint does NOT enforce idempotency via the Idempotency-Key header. Processor creates duplicate records.

reason_field_roundtrip.conclusion: The reason field round-trips reliably across both payments.retrieve().refunds and refunds.retrieve(). However, metadata is not exposed in list/nested views. Therefore, Purser MUST embed deterministic action_id fingerprints inside the reason field (e.g., 'action_id:<sha256[:24]>:<rule_id>') to enable Dead Reckoning reconciliation.
